profile_text: With a strong connection to the Düsseldorf region, this construction company has experienced significant growth of 52.9% since its baseline, driven by its commitment to sustainable building practices and harmony with nature. Operating from its base on Spangerstraße 36, the company has expanded its workforce to 26 employees in 2024, solidifying its position as a scaler in the construction sector. Its focus on regional roots and environmental responsibility has likely contributed to its success and increasing presence in the market.
